domains.name: Test Analysis & Design
domains.proves: Designing good tests from requirements and risk

domains.name: Security Testing
domains.proves: Finding security weaknesses before attackers do

domains.name: AI Testing
domains.proves: Testing AI systems and testing with AI

domains.name: Test Management & Leadership
domains.proves: Leading test teams, strategy and process

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Where everyone starts. No experience needed.

levels.name: Specialist
levels.description: One focused topic, built on the foundation.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Senior testers and test leaders. Several years of experience required.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) v4.0
certifications.what: Testing fundamentals, terminology, static testing, test techniques and test management. The prerequisite for almost every other ISTQB certification.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Model-Based Tester (CT-MBT)
certifications.what: Using models to design and generate tests, making test design more effective and efficient.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Acceptance Testing (CT-AcT)
certifications.what: Acceptance testing together with product owners, business analysts and users: user acceptance, contractual and regulatory acceptance, and alpha and beta testing.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level Test Analyst (CTAL-TA) v4.0
certifications.what: Structured functional testing across the life cycle, with in-depth black-box test techniques and user-focused non-functional testing. Replaced v3.1, whose English exams ended in May 2026.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL and sufficient practical experience; the exact criteria are set by each exam board.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level Technical Test Analyst (CTAL-TTA) v4.0
certifications.what: Technical testing: risk-based testing, white-box techniques, static and dynamic analysis, and non-functional qualities such as performance and security.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL and sufficient practical experience; the exact criteria are set by each exam board.

certifications.name: Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1
certifications.what: Codeless, model-based test automation basics in Tricentis Tosca: modules, test cases, execution and reporting. The first step of the Tricentis Academy Automation Specialist path.
certifications.before: Reported to have no prerequisites. The Tricentis Academy courses (login required) are the usual preparation.

certifications.name: Robot Framework Certified Professional (RFCP)
certifications.what: The foundational Robot Framework certification: keyword-driven automation, syntax, control structures, running tests and using external libraries. Launched in 2025; exams through GASQ.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. Training with an accredited provider is optional.

certifications.name: Tricentis Tosca Test Design Specialist Level 1
certifications.what: Test case design and test data management in Tosca. Followed by TDS2.
certifications.before: Reported to be aimed at people with little or no Tosca test design experience. Preparation is through the Tricentis Academy (login required).

certifications.name: Katalon Practitioner Certification
certifications.what: Foundational test automation in Katalon Studio: test cases, test objects, suites and data-driven testing. Earned by completing hands-on activities in the product, not by an exam. Valid for 2 years.
certifications.before: No prior experience required. Works with the free version of Katalon Studio.

certifications.name: ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Test Automation (ICP-ATA)
certifications.what: Designing and implementing end-to-end test automation in agile and continuous integration environments: automation strategy, frameworks, choosing what to automate and running tests in the build.
certifications.before: No prerequisites listed. Earned through an ICAgile-accredited course; the fee depends on the training provider.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Test Automation Strategy (CT-TAS)
certifications.what: Planning test automation at organisation level: goals, scope, costs, rollout, metrics and the value it delivers.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL and sufficient practical experience; the exact criteria are set by each exam board.

certifications.name: A4Q Certified Selenium 4 Tester Foundation
certifications.what: Web test automation with Selenium 4 in Java or Python: WebDriver, locators and XPath, page objects, keyword- and data-driven solutions, and Selenium Grid. Exams through GASQ and iSQI.
certifications.before: Basic programming knowledge in Java with Maven, or in Python. A course is optional.

certifications.name: Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 2
certifications.what: Structuring test data with TestSheets, templates and instantiation, data-driven testing and API test cases in Tosca.
certifications.before: Reported to require Tosca AS1. Preparation is through the Tricentis Academy (login required).

certifications.name: Tricentis Tosca Test Design Specialist Level 2
certifications.what: Advanced test case design (combinatorics, templates, instances) and test data management with the Tosca Test Data Service.
certifications.before: Reported to be aimed at people with a solid foundation in Tosca test design, following TDS1.

certifications.name: Katalon Professional Certification
certifications.what: Advanced automation in Katalon Studio Enterprise: custom keywords, AI-generated test artifacts, parallel and data-driven execution, debugging and CLI or cloud runs. Earned through product usage, not an exam. Valid for 2 years.
certifications.before: Katalon Practitioner is recommended but not required. The certification is free, but it needs Katalon Studio Enterprise (paid; a 30-day trial is available).

certifications.name: OpenText Unified Functional Testing One (UFT One) Developer Certification Exam (5-5810)
certifications.what: Automated functional testing with UFT One. 60 questions in 2 hours.
certifications.before: No prerequisites listed. Aimed at testers, QA engineers, DevOps team members and QA leads; OpenText rates it Intermediate.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE) v2.0
certifications.what: Designing, building and maintaining reliable test automation solutions and architectures across the life cycle.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL and sufficient practical experience; the exact criteria are set by each exam board. Software engineering skills are expected.

certifications.name: Tricentis Tosca Automation Engineer Level 1
certifications.what: Advanced Tosca automation: TBox and classic steering, Win32, AnyUI and UIA, Excel and PDF testing, image-based controls and custom controls. Followed by AE2.
certifications.before: Reported to require Tosca AS2.

certifications.name: Tricentis Tosca Automation Engineer Level 2
certifications.what: Automating beyond web applications with Tosca, continuing from AE1.
certifications.before: Reported to build on AS1 and AS2, following AE1.

certifications.name: Tricentis Tosca Test Architect
certifications.what: Tricentis's highest Tosca credential: designing and leading Tosca test automation at scale, assessed through a practical challenge marked by Tricentis.
certifications.before: Reported to be invitation-based and to require AS1, AS2, TDS1, TDS2 and AE1 plus an entry challenge and real project experience.

certifications.name: ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Testing (ICP-TST)
certifications.what: The agile testing mindset: testing quadrants, whole-team collaboration, TDD, ATDD, BDD and specification by example, and regression testing. No renewal fees.
certifications.before: No prerequisites listed. Earned through an ICAgile-accredited course; the fee depends on the training provider.

certifications.name: TMAP® Quality for cross-functional teams
certifications.what: Built-in quality for DevOps and Scrum teams with the TMAP body of knowledge: the VOICE model, continuous quality engineering, test automation, CI/CD and test design. Replaced TMap NEXT.
certifications.before: No required certificates. Basic IT and agile knowledge is an advantage; a 3-day course is recommended.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Quality in DevOps (CT-QDO)
certifications.what: Applying quality and test practices across DevOps pipelines and continuous delivery. Released May 2026.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Agile Test Leadership at Scale (CT-ATLaS)
certifications.what: Organising and improving quality and testing across multiple teams in an agile organisation.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL v4.0, or an earlier CTFL plus CTFL Agile Tester, and sufficient practical experience.

certifications.name: TMAP® High-performance quality engineering
certifications.what: Operational quality engineering in DevOps and Scrum teams: quality risk analysis, test strategy, acceptance criteria, test design, monitoring and reporting.
certifications.before: Basic knowledge of IT, teamwork and agile working is required. TMAP QCFT is strongly advised first.

certifications.name: TMAP® Organizing built-in quality at scale
certifications.what: Organising quality engineering across teams: QA and test policies, quality characteristics, metrics, CI/CD pipelines and continuous improvement.
certifications.before: Basic knowledge of IT, teamwork and agile working is required. TMAP QCFT is strongly advised first.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level Agile Tester (CTAL-AT) v2.0
certifications.what: Agile test strategy, whole-team collaboration and shift-left practices for experienced testers. Released May 2026, replacing CTFL-AT and CT-ATT.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ASTQB IoT and Mobile Testing Certification
certifications.what: Testing Internet of Things devices, mobile applications and connected systems. The expanded successor to the ASTQB Certified Mobile Tester. 40 questions in 60 minutes.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Performance Testing (CT-PT)
certifications.what: Planning, running and analysing performance and load tests, including measurements and tool selection.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: OpenText LoadRunner Professional Developer Certification Exam (5-5730)
certifications.what: Performance testing with LoadRunner Professional: Virtual User Generator, Controller and Analysis. 60 questions in 2 hours.
certifications.before: No prerequisites listed. Aimed at performance test engineers and leads; OpenText suggests its LoadRunner Professional courses.

certifications.name: OpenText LoadRunner Enterprise Analyst Certification Exam (5-5735)
certifications.what: Performance testing with LoadRunner Enterprise: scripts, planning and running load tests, analysing results, and managing projects, roles and test environments. 60 questions in 2 hours.
certifications.before: No prerequisites listed. Aimed at performance test engineers, analysts and leads; OpenText rates it Intermediate.

certifications.name: Tricentis NeoLoad Professional Certification
certifications.what: Performance and load testing with Tricentis NeoLoad. Reported to be a 50-question, 90-minute exam with an 80% pass mark.
certifications.before: Reported to have no formal prerequisites. Preparation is through the Tricentis Academy (login required).

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Mobile Application Testing (CT-MAT)
certifications.what: Methods, techniques and tools for testing mobile applications across platforms, devices and connectivity types.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Automotive Software Tester (CT-AuT)
certifications.what: Testing automotive electrical and electronic systems under Automotive SPICE, ISO 26262 and AUTOSAR, including testing in virtual environments.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Game Testing (CT-GaMe)
certifications.what: Testing video games: mechanics, graphics, sound, localisation and player experience.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL and sufficient practical experience; the exact criteria are set by each exam board.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Gambling Industry Tester (CT-GT)
certifications.what: Testing gambling software, including compliance, game math, platform and online gambling testing.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Finance Testing (CT-FT)
certifications.what: Testing financial services software: regulatory compliance, risk-based testing, data accuracy and test automation in regulated environments. Released May 2026.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Security Tester (CT-SEC)
certifications.what: Planning, performing and evaluating security tests from risk, requirements, vulnerability and human-factor angles. ISTQB is splitting it into CT-STE and the upcoming CT-STA.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL and at least 3 years of relevant academic, practical or consulting experience.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Security Test Engineer (CT-STE)
certifications.what: Planning, designing and executing security tests, choosing security test tools and feeding results into an ISMS. Launched February 2025 as one of two successors to CT-SEC; CT-SEC holders are not grandfathered.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: Web Application Penetration Tester (eWPT)
certifications.what: Hands-on web application penetration testing in a simulated real-world engagement, from information gathering to manual exploitation and web service testing. Valid for 3 years.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. Aimed at people with a basic understanding of networks and systems and foundational web pentesting experience. Requires an INE subscription and an exam voucher.

certifications.name: OffSec Web Assessor (OSWA)
certifications.what: A 24-hour proctored practical exam: find and exploit vulnerabilities such as XSS, SQL injection, SSRF and XXE in five web targets. Earned through the WEB-200 course. Does not expire.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. OffSec recommends a basic understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), networking and Linux.

certifications.name: Mobile Application Penetration Tester (eMAPT)
certifications.what: Hands-on penetration testing of real Android and iOS apps: reconnaissance, dynamic testing, API security, reverse engineering, malware analysis and reporting. Valid for 3 years.
certifications.before: Aimed at people with intermediate mobile application security experience, as the next step after INE's eJPT and eCPPT. Requires an INE subscription and an exam voucher.

certifications.name: Burp Suite Certified Practitioner
certifications.what: A 4-hour practical exam: find and exploit vulnerabilities in two web applications with Burp Suite, from a user account to admin access to reading a file on the server. Valid for 5 years.
certifications.before: Requires a Burp Suite Professional subscription to take the exam. Aimed at penetration testers; the Web Security Academy labs are the usual preparation.

certifications.name: GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT)
certifications.what: Web application penetration testing methodology and exploits: reconnaissance, authentication and session attacks, SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Proctored exam with hands-on CyberLive questions.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites listed. Aimed at penetration testers, security practitioners and web developers.

certifications.name: Web Application Penetration Tester eXtreme (eWPTX)
certifications.what: INE's advanced practical web application penetration testing exam: API testing, injection, authentication attacks and reconnaissance. Valid for 3 years.
certifications.before: Designed for advanced security professionals with deep penetration testing experience. Requires an INE subscription and an exam voucher.

certifications.name: OffSec Web Expert (OSWE)
certifications.what: White-box web application exploitation: analysing source code, chaining logic flaws into working exploits. A 48-hour proctored practical exam, earned through the WEB-300 course. Does not expire.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. Aimed at experienced penetration testers; OffSec expects coding and scripting skills, Linux and experience with web proxies.

certifications.name: Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC)
certifications.what: IAAP's foundational certification: disabilities, accessibility and universal design, and accessibility laws, standards and management strategies.
certifications.before: 1 year of accessibility experience, a new role with some responsibility for accessibility, or the wish to move into accessibility.

certifications.name: UXQB Foundation in Human-Centred Design (CPUX-F)
certifications.what: Foundations of usability, user experience and human-centred design based on ISO 9241-210. 40 questions in 75 minutes.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: A4Q Certified Professional Digital Accessibility
certifications.what: Accessibility principles, user groups, WCAG, EN 301 549 and the EU Accessibility Act, with manual and automated accessibility testing (axe, WAVE, Lighthouse). Exams through GASQ and iSQI.
certifications.before: No prerequisites listed. A course with an accredited provider is recommended.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Usability Testing (CT-UT)
certifications.what: Usability and user experience evaluation methods, including accessibility.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: Accessible Document Specialist (ADS)
certifications.what: Creating, evaluating and remediating accessible documents (word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF) against PDF/UA, the Matterhorn Protocol and WCAG 2.1.
certifications.before: 1–2 years of experience in accessible document authoring or remediation. Not intended for beginners.

certifications.name: Web Accessibility Specialist (WAS)
certifications.what: Technical web accessibility: writing, testing and fixing accessible code against WCAG, including assistive technology.
certifications.before: 3–5 years of hands-on experience writing, testing and fixing accessible code.

certifications.name: UXQB Usability Testing and Evaluation (CPUX-UT)
certifications.what: Planning, running, analysing and reporting usability tests and expert reviews. A 90-minute theory exam plus a practical exam in which you run and document a real remote usability test.
certifications.before: No required certificates; UXQB strongly recommends knowing the CPUX-F curriculum first.

certifications.name: Certified Professional in Web Accessibility (CPWA)
certifications.what: IAAP's highest credential, awarded to people who pass both CPACC and WAS. It replaces the two, so you maintain a single certification.
certifications.before: Requires CPACC and WAS; the second must be earned while the first is still valid.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester AI Testing (CT-AI) v2.0
certifications.what: Testing AI-based systems, including machine learning and generative AI, and their probabilistic, data-dependent behaviour. Replaces v1.0, whose English exams run until April 2027. See the AI Certification Roadmap for the wider AI landscape.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Testing with Generative AI (CT-GenAI)
certifications.what: Using LLMs across the test process: prompt engineering, test design, automation, reporting and managing AI risks. Launched July 2025.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL.

certifications.name: TMMi Professional
certifications.what: The TMMi model for assessing and improving test processes, including in agile and DevOps contexts. The prerequisite for becoming an accredited TMMi assessor.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. A training course is optional; exams through iSQI, GASQ, Brightest and Certible.

certifications.name: Tricentis qTest Specialist Level 1
certifications.what: Managing and designing test projects in qTest Manager.
certifications.before: Reported to have no prerequisites. Self-paced through the Tricentis Academy (login required).

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level Test Management (CTAL-TM) v3.0
certifications.what: Managing testing across the life cycle: test strategy, planning, risk, metrics, reporting, team development and process improvement.
certifications.before: Requires ISTQB CTFL and sufficient practical experience; the exact criteria are set by each exam board.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Expert Level Test Management (CTEL-TM)
certifications.what: Strategic and operational test management and managing the test team. Three parts with an exam each (CTEL-TM-SM, -OTM and -MTT). Valid for 7 years.
certifications.before: Requires CTFL, CTAL-TM, at least 5 years of practical testing experience and at least 2 years in test management.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Expert Level Improving the Test Process (CTEL-ITP)
certifications.what: Assessing an organisation's test process and implementing improvements. Two parts with an exam each (CTEL-ITP-ATP and -ITPI). Valid for 7 years.
certifications.before: Requires CTFL, CTAL-TM, at least 5 years of practical testing experience and at least 2 years in test process improvement.

certifications.name: TMMi Test Process Improver
certifications.what: Recognises people who can lead test process improvement with the TMMi model. Awarded on evidence of certificates and experience rather than an exam.
certifications.before: Requires TMMi Professional, two testing certificates beyond ISTQB CTFL (for example Advanced Level), and proven process assessment and improvement experience.
